The review criteria loosen by round: 3 = Normal / Important / Final, 4 = Normal x2 / Important / Final, 5 = Normal x2 / Important x2 / Final. Tickets already in progress keep the limit they started with.

appSettings.restartNote: Changes here take effect the next time the server starts (saved to: {{path}}).
appSettings.restartNoteNoPath: Settings are saved to your home config file ($HOME/.graph-ops/config.json). Your home directory could not be resolved, so there is nowhere to save them and the server is running on environment variables and built-in defaults. They take effect after a restart.
appSettings.homeConfigUnreadable: {{path}} could not be read, so none of the settings on this page are in effect -- the values shown come from environment variables and built-in defaults -- and saving here fails until it is fixed. Repair or delete that file.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.dbBackendSwitchHint: Switching only changes which database is used -- no data is migrated. Each backend keeps its own data as-is.
storage.artifactsDirHint: A shared directory for investigation material and temporary files. Artifacts themselves are stored in the database, so putting files here is optional. When an html/image artifact is registered by file path, only files under this directory can be read.
storage.mysqlPasswordFromEnvHint: Loaded from the environment variable "{{envVar}}" (not stored in plaintext).
storage.mysqlPasswordPlaintextHint: This value is stored in plaintext in your home config file ($HOME/.graph-ops/config.json). To load it from an environment variable instead, enter it as "${ENV_VAR_NAME}".
storage.mysqlPasswordSavedHint: A password is already saved. The server never sends it back to this screen, so leave this field empty to keep it, or type a new value to replace it.
storage.mysqlRequiredFieldsHint: Host, database name and user are required when MySQL is selected. The CA certificate path is also required when the TLS mode is "Verify CA only".
storage.mysqlPasswordRetypeHint: You have changed the connection (host, port, database name, user or TLS setting). The saved password (or "${ENV_VAR}" reference) is only ever used for the connection it was saved for, so enter it again before testing or saving. To reuse the same environment variable reference for a new connection, first save the connection change with the password field left empty, then enter the same reference again and save once more.
storage.mysqlPasswordRetypeOtherBackendHint: The MySQL connection (host, port, database name, user or TLS setting) has been changed, and the saved password (or "${ENV_VAR}" reference) is only ever used for the connection it was saved for. Select MySQL as the storage backend and enter it again, or put the connection back the way it was, before saving.
storage.mysqlTlsVerifyFullHint: Verifies both the server certificate's chain and its hostname. This is the default. It cannot connect to a server that does not support TLS, or one using a self-signed/auto-generated certificate (such as MySQL's own out-of-the-box certificate) -- use "Verify CA only" for those.
storage.mysqlTlsVerifyCaHint: Verifies the certificate's chain against the CA certificate below, but not the hostname. Use this when the certificate and hostname cannot be expected to match, such as MySQL's auto-generated certificate (which carries no hostname). The CA certificate file below is required.
storage.mysqlTlsDisabledWarning: Warning: this connection is not encrypted. Traffic, including the password, can be read or tampered with in transit. Only choose this for a server that does not support TLS.
storage.mysqlTlsCaHint: An absolute path to a PEM-format CA certificate file. Left empty under "Verify certificate and hostname", the OS's trusted root certificates are used instead. When set, this CA is the only one trusted (the OS trust store is not also consulted).
storage.mysqlTlsCaRequiredHint: The CA certificate file path is required when the TLS mode is "Verify CA only".
storage.httpUrlHint: The base URL of the plugin (an HTTP server). Plaintext http:// is only allowed for a loopback address (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1); use https:// for anything else.
storage.httpTokenPlaintextHint: This value is stored in plaintext in your home config file ($HOME/.graph-ops/config.json). To load it from an environment variable instead, enter it as "${ENV_VAR_NAME}".
storage.httpTokenFromEnvHint: Loaded from the environment variable "{{envVar}}" (not stored in plaintext).
storage.httpTokenSavedHint: A token is already saved. The server never sends it back to this screen, so leave this field empty to keep it, or type a new value to replace it.
storage.httpTokenRetypeHint: You have changed the endpoint URL, so the saved token (or "${ENV_VAR}" reference) can no longer be used. Enter the token for the new URL.
storage.httpUrlRequiredHint: The endpoint URL is required when the HTTP custom data source is selected.
storage.httpUrlInvalidHint: The endpoint URL must start with http:// or https:// and must not contain user information, a query or a fragment.
storage.httpPlaintextRemoteHint: Plaintext http:// is only allowed for a loopback address (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1). Use https:// instead.
storage.httpTokenRequiredHint: A remote data source requires a bearer token.

myProfile.title: My Profile

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.invalidPageSize: Enter an integer of 1 or greater.

teamExtensionsDir.title: Team Settings Directory
teamExtensionsDir.description: A settings directory shared by your team. When set, its node-type instructions, workflow and review gates (workflow.yaml), templates, skill instructions and autopilot settings (autopilot.yaml) take precedence over your personal settings. Leave it blank for no shared settings: only your personal settings (~/.graph-ops) are used. Personal settings such as the DB connection, project paths, your name and the language are never changed by the team directory. Enter an absolute path. Takes effect after the server restarts (the GRAPH_TEAM_EXTENSIONS_DIR environment variable, if set, takes precedence).

autopilot.description: Settings used when autopilot (autopilot-ticket / autopilot-tree) runs in this project. Values saved here go to this environment's local settings (~/.graph-ops/config.json). permissionMode.hint: The permission mode (claude --permission-mode) of the child session started for each ticket.

autoApproveGates.hint: When off, approval gates wait for a person as usual.

onFailure.hint: Stop the whole run, or skip only that ticket's subtree and continue.

stallTimeoutMinutes.hint: A child session with no sign of activity for this long is treated as failed. 15-1440.

errors.HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: The request was blocked because this address is not one the server answers to. Open the UI at the address the server prints on startup (localhost by default).

errors.LABEL_NOT_FOUND: Label not found. It was deleted or belongs to another project.

errors.INVALID_LABEL_COLOR: Invalid label color. Choose one from the palette.
errors.API_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: That API endpoint does not exist on this server. The app and the server may be running different versions; reload the page and try again.
errors.REQUEST_BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request was too large for the server to accept. Try again with a smaller file or less content.
errors.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: That address is no longer served by this server. Open what you were looking for from the Web UI rather than from a saved link or bookmark.

errors.HTTP_DATASOURCE_TOKEN_RETYPE_REQUIRED: The saved token cannot be used for a different endpoint URL. Enter the token again after changing the URL.
errors.HOME_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE: Your home directory could not be resolved, so there is no config file to save to and nothing was saved. Settings are only ever read from $HOME/.graph-ops/config.json and environment variables.
errors.AUTOPILOT_SETTING_LOCKED: Settings fixed by the team settings cannot be saved. Save again without changing them.
errors.AUTOPILOT_ALREADY_RUNNING: An autopilot run is already running on a tree that includes this ticket. Wait for it to finish, or start again once it has stopped.
errors.AUTOPILOT_ROOT_FINISHED: This ticket is DONE or CLOSED, so no autopilot can be started from it. To process an unfinished descendant, start from that ticket.
